events.title: And... Reunion Fate Early Access 1.0.0 is finished
events.summary: I'm pleased to announce that the first Early Access version of Reunion Fate is finally finished. There's no need to create anything new, no need to add anything new; I just need to improve what's already there. events.title: Early Access is coming soon (WIP)
events.summary: I can finally say that I'm at a pretty decent stage where I can release the Early Access version with good content while I prepare the next update.

events.title: FEATURE: Play WITH a CONTROLLER
events.summary: A new gameplay feature has been added. Reunion Fate is now 98% controller compatible, so please read the following before playing:Experimental function: Controller compatibilityFrom this new version of the DEMO onwards (including future Early Access), you'll be able to play with a controller without having to use a mouse or keyboard for configuration. However, there are some important points to note:The controller feature currently includes the presence of a cursor to navigate and interact with

events.title: Minor improvements
events.summary: Changes:Solomon's dialogue has been reduced and changed before and after hiding under the table.Fixes:Solomon's dialogue overlapping when explaining the hiding mechanic has been fixed.Noor's dialogue when interacting with the lighthouse has been corrected; it will now only appear once per playthrough.

events.title: So that nobody gets lost
events.summary: I'm making this update after receiving feedback that some users were confused by the zombie mission, so to prevent this from happening again:Moris's mission book is now easier to distinguish during the mission.Moris's dialogue has been modified to be more direct about where to look.

events.title: Bugs 2x1
events.summary: The following bugs have been fixed:- The bug that caused the window to minimize when the "Exit when switching windows" option was selected, along with Resolution, Language, or Window Mode, has been fixed.- A bug accidentally introduced by the developer while trying to fix the previous bug has been fixed.

events.title: Reunion Fate Demo Page
events.summary: Honestly, I thought the process would take longer, but it didn't.I would be extremely grateful if you could leave a positive review of the game. It would be a great help.And to those who had problems with the demo, I apologize, and if you can, please join the Discord server where you can explain the problem so it can be resolved, if it hasn't been fixed already.

events.title: The Future of Reunion Fate
events.summary: One of the things I'd like to announce is that I'm still working on the rest of the Reunion Fate content for those who enjoyed the demo and want to continue the story. Currently, I'm preparing the content for the game's upcoming Early Access release, but at the same time, I'm continuing to update the demo version to implement the improvements I'm adding to the "main" version of Reunion Fate. events.title: Reunion Fate OUT NOW!!
events.summary: Finally, my game is available to everyone. I'm honestly incredibly proud that this has finally happened.And I can finally announce that I'm still working on many more things. What's available now is just a small sample of everything I'm building. There's still a lot to do, and if you like what you see, there will be more content about Noor and the people of Ophidia very soon.
